news.title: Flamingos: Tinubu announces ₦100m reward for each player, sets condition

President Bola Tinubu has rewarded each member of Nigeria's Flamingos with ₦100 million following their historic victory at the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup in Morocco. Nigeria defeated Japan 2-1 in the final to secure the historic title in Morocco. Awawu Bashiru opened the scoring in the 39th minute before Oluebube Umejiaku doubled the Flamingos' advantage shortly after the restart.

news.title: Flamingos Get N100m Each From Tinubu After Nigeria's U-17 World Cup Win
news.lede: President Bola Tinubu has pledged N100 million to each member of the Flamingos, Nigeria's Under-17 women's national football team, after the squad became the first African side to lift the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup in Morocco. The announcement was made on Wednesday, when the players and their coaching staff were received at the Presidential Villa in Abuja. First Lady Oluremi Tinubu delivered the reward announcement on the president's behalf during the reception. The head coach will collect N100 million, and every member of the technical crew will receive N50 million.

news.title: McTominay reveals he underwent heart shock procedure during World Cup with Scotland
news.lede: Napoli midfielder Scott McTominay has revealed the cardiac problems that prompted his surgery started playing for Scotland at the 2026 World Cup. ‘I got the shock on my heart two days before the Haiti game.’ The 29-year-old was diagnosed with a mild, benign arrhythmia and removed from the Napoli squad after the first two Serie A rounds of the season, on September 1. He visited a specialist in Manchester and had the surgery on September 8, a corrective procedure using pulsed-field ablation (PFA), returning to the field on October 10.

news.title: Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup: Tom and Joe Coyd looking to take England to successive World Cup titles as France await in final
news.lede: A second successive World Cup win would take England Wheelchair men's side to unparalleled heights in Rugby League - but for Tom and Joe Coyd, the matter of the final is still very much a family affair. Already a World Cup winning coach, Tom has been in charge of England for six years, with younger brother and star winger Joe scoring 12 tries on the way to their last national team success at 2022's tournament. The task of securing a second world title in a row - something only Friday's opponents, France, have managed - is already a tall task, but Tom has battled with what he feels is an even tougher challenge throughout the tournament. news.title: Breaking: Tinubu Receives Flamingos After U-17 World Cup Win
news.lede: PAY ATTENTION: Mark Legit.ng as a preferred source, and our content will appear higher in your Google feed! First Lady Oluremi Tinubu on Wednesday received members of Nigeria's U-17 women's football team, the Flamingos, at the Presidential Villa in Abuja, acting on behalf of President Bola Tinubu to honour the team following their historic World Cup victory. The Flamingos recently clinched the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup title, a landmark achievement for Nigerian women's football that drew widespread celebration across the country. The reception at the Presidential Villa marked the federal government's formal acknowledgement of the team's feat.

news.title: Inside the system: How spain built a 43-match unbeaten Run and Fifa World Cup glory
news.lede: Spain aim to extend their 43-match unbeaten run this week in the Uefa Nations League, with the playing philosophy that propelled them to World Cup glory this summer the product of years of work at every level of the game. Their approach combines a clearly defined playing style, early talent identification, and a coaching structure designed to ensure players learn the same principles as they progress through the youth ranks. "For us there is clearly a turning point in 2008, when (then Spain national team coach) Luis Aragonés won the European Championship," David Gutiérrez, director of the Spanish football federation's (RFEF) national school of coaches, revealed on a visit to their Las Rozas base. Aragonés's Spain played in a new way.
